method: All 925 video frames decoded to 480x270 RGB; per-frame luma, bright coverage, centroid and absolute frame change saved. Visually inspected 0.5-second contact sheets plus 0.1-second samples from 15–18 seconds. Original timestamp-matched larger frames inspected in comparison sheets. No reference pixels used in renderer.
timing_precision: Stage boundaries are visual estimates, generally +/-0.1–0.3 seconds, not recovered authoring keyframes. The 3.766667-second field cut is detected at frame 113 in the every-frame difference trace. Rates/easing/depth descriptions are qualitative observations, not measured optical flow.

short.name: Star field / flying fragments
short.composition: Full frame, most brightness below center
short.motion: Swirling/tumbling fragments, drifting laterally and into depth; no recoverable exact velocity
short.particles: Hundreds of varied-size stars and fragments, high contrast

short.name: Vertical rain
short.composition: Mostly central columns spanning the frame
short.motion: Predominantly vertical streaks, downward trails; apparent speed varies with depth
short.particles: Sparse bright heads, dotted tails, narrow elongated lights

short.name: Portrait assembly
short.composition: Head near x=.55, y=.28; shoulders widen through lower half
short.motion: Streaks coalesce into face/hair/shoulders; motion settles smoothly
short.particles: Scattered high-luma contour samples and long vertical strands
short.transition: Gradual spatial accumulation, not a full photograph fade

short.name: Portrait hold
short.composition: Approx. bounds x=.22–.73, y=.04–1; source pose is asymmetric
short.motion: Near-static face; small particles continue near bottom
short.particles: Black facial/clothing areas, white brows/edges, sparse vertical shirt trails

extended.name: Faceted metallic star
extended.composition: Initially oversized, centered; contracts to central luminous point
extended.motion: Rotation and rapid recession / scale decrease; eased settling
extended.particles: No dense particle field yet; concentrated glow
extended.transition: Starts black at frame 0, bright star at frame 1, shrinks into black

extended.name: Jeweled S
extended.composition: Centered letter, approx. width .33 and height .62
extended.motion: Fragmented/partial emergence, then stable letter with glints
extended.particles: Close regular crystal grid, cool highlights
extended.transition: Bright expansion/flash around frames 110–112; cut to field at frame 113

extended.name: Stars and flying fragments
extended.composition: Low sparkling horizon then scattered across full frame
extended.particles: Hundreds of stars, several larger foreground stars

extended.name: Digital rain onset
extended.motion: Vertical elongated lights, fast local streaking
extended.particles: Sparse bright lights with dotted/continuous tails

extended.name: Portrait assembly
extended.composition: Head approx x=.55, y=.27; torso approx x=.22–.72
extended.motion: Contours consolidate; long strands settle, small apparent framing change
extended.particles: Fine silver points and vertical lines; strong rim highlights

extended.name: Portrait hold
extended.composition: Head and torso fill most of image height; deep surrounding black
extended.motion: Very limited portrait motion; ambient particles below
extended.particles: Dense hair/face texture, sparse shirt lines; black negative space

extended.name: Portrait to first title
extended.composition: Centered two-line title over fading portrait
extended.motion: Portrait dims while dots form title
extended.particles: Dispersing floor particles and jewel assembly

extended.name: THARAN / CREATIONS reference card
extended.composition: Centered stacked serif lines; safe margins
extended.motion: Slow enlargement; glints travel over letters

extended.name: SURYA / THARAN reference card
extended.motion: Dots appear sequentially; stable short hold

adaptation.later_credits: Empty configurable credit slots; main name held through them. The original blue credit card and subsequent copy are not reproduced.
adaptation.portrait: Supplied 1600x899 stylized JPEG. Uniform-scale masked composition preserves pose and features, so shoulder breadth and head inclination differ.
adaptation.flash: Reference full-screen flash is replaced with a softened transition.

short_audio_landmarks.measurement: 0.1s RMS blocks after 8 kHz mono analysis resampling; no semantic listening claims. Stereo original peak measured separately for output headroom.

extended_audio_landmarks.measurement: 0.1s RMS blocks after 8 kHz mono analysis resampling; no semantic listening claims. Stereo original peak measured separately for output headroom.
